title.narrative: Enhancing Capacity for Resource Mobilization and Strengthening cooperation with Partners and Donors at the UNESCO Addis Ababa Liaison Office

description.narrative: The activity aims to bolster the Addis Ababa Liaison Office's capacity for effective engagement in resource mobilization, crucial for the successful implementation of its strategic objectives. Activities will focus on enhancing technical capacity for donor mapping, developing compelling communication and visibility materials, and facilitating strategic meetings with potential donors. This initiative is vital for the Liaison Office's involvement in more than ten working groups under four pillars of the Ethiopia-United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2020-2025, as well as its participation in the AU Specialized Technical Committees. The expected outcomes include a strengthened office capable of securing additional funding for UNESCO projects in Africa, particularly those aimed at governance, peace building, economic recovery, and resilience to climate change.
